autotag.description: autotag job started, or autotag queued while another job holds the slot

position.description: Place in the order set on the Categories page, lowest first; list responses come in this order

name.description: The label; images/search?q=collection:"<name>"&sort=order pages its members in reading order

CreateImageResponse.description: Bare Image on success; wrapped in {image, tag_warnings?, rejected_tags?, autotag?} when a tag was refused, a name is rejected in the gallery or autotag was requested.

autotag.description: Human-readable status about the auto-tag job

rejected_tags.description: Pushed names the gallery rejects, dropped and counted; the rest landed.

finished.description: Jobs finished since the server started. It only grows, so a poller that saw it below this value knows a job ended even after the status bar dropped it

galleries.description: The galleries it writes to; empty stands for all of them

partial.description: Finished with part of the work left undone

type.description: sync, autotag, tag, delete, move, relations, ...

queued.description: Images waiting in the auto-tag queue for the slot

running.description: The job slot is held: a job runs, or a scheduled run sits between its phases. A job started now would wait or be refused

folder.description: The removed folder, relative to the gallery root

folder_deleted.description: True when delete_empty_folder removed the emptied folder

kept_changed_files.description: The image's files kept on disk because they no longer hold its bytes

DuplicateImageResponse.description: Returned when the posted file's SHA-256 is already known. The existing image is returned with the pushed tags and provenance merged in. A multipart upload's redundant copy is discarded; a JSON path-reference at a new path is recorded as an alias.

alias_added.description: True when the posted path was recorded as an alias of the existing image (JSON path-reference); false when a redundant multipart upload was discarded

rejected_tags.description: Pushed names the gallery rejects, dropped and counted.

verified.description: False when verify was requested but the source reported no md5, or when a similarity-matched origin's differing file was applied unverified

active.description: True for the gallery used when no ?gallery= selector is given

api.description: The API version this monbooru speaks

app.description: Always monbooru, so a second launch can tell its own instance from another program on the port

min_peer_api.description: The oldest monloader API version it works with

annotations.description: Positional note boxes pulled per source, in original-image pixel coordinates. Omitted when empty.

body.description: The stored body, in monbooru's annotation markup.

body_text.description: The body flattened to plain text. Present only when the body carries markup.

post_id.description: The post on that site; omitted when the source has none.

site.description: The source site the note came from.

collection.description: Home collection label - mirrors the first entry of 'collections'. Empty string when unset. Filtered by the search keyword 'collection:' (exact match). Settable on create and via PATCH /images/{id}.

collection_order.description: 1-based position within the home collection. Null when unset. Settable on create and via PATCH /images/{id}.

collections.description: Every collection the image belongs to. The scalar collection / collection_order fields mirror the home membership. Managed through the web UI; the API sets the home via collection / collection_order, and a duplicate push files the image into its collection as a further membership.

order.description: 1-based position within this collection. Null when unset.

is_inbox.description: true = needs triage (sits in the inbox); false = curated. New ingests default to true.

last_result.description: 'hit' or 'miss'; absent while nothing has concluded

next_due_at.description: When the backend may try again; absent when no scheduled run will try it

lookup.description: Recorded lookup history per backend ('ptr' / 'booru'), absent when nothing has ever been tried. Single-image GET only.

md5.description: md5 of the stored file, "" until computed. The local digest, not the md5 an origin claims

note.description: Operator's freeform note. Never written by a push or enrich.

origin.description: How the image got into the gallery: 'ingest' for watcher/sync, 'upload' for the web UI, or any caller-supplied string (app name, URL...) set via POST /images with 'via'

original_source.description: Legacy image-level original source URL. Read-only: only a gallery transfer still carries it.

page_count.description: Number of pages for cbz / manga rows; null on every other file type.

phash.description: 16-char hex perceptual hash; null until the phash backfill or ingest has populated it.

scheduled_lookup.description: Whether the nightly online-booru lookup considers this image. Single-image GET only. Settable via PATCH /images/{id}; setting it true also resets an exhausted retry ladder.

scheduled_lookup_ptr.description: The same opt-in for the nightly PTR lookup, which is free per image and has its own ladder. Single-image GET only, settable the same way.

source.description: Site label of the primary (first) entry of 'sources'. Empty string when the image has no origin. Filtered by the search keyword 'source:' which matches any of the image's sources. Settable on create and via PATCH /images/{id}.

source_type.description: Generation-tool source: 'a1111', 'comfyui', 'a1111,comfyui', or 'none'. Filtered by the search keyword 'ai:'.

sources.description: Every origin the image came from. The scalar source / url fields mirror the primary (first) origin. PATCH edits the primary through source / url; a push or enrich adds or updates the origin it names.

commentary.description: Artist commentary pulled from (or hand-entered for) this origin; omitted when empty.

commentary_translated.description: Translation of that commentary where the source published one; omitted when empty.

original.description: Upstream artist source the post declared (usually a URL, newline-joined when several); omitted when empty.

post_id.description: Upstream post id; omitted for a manually-added origin.

similarity.description: The latest positive similarity-service score a lookup matched this origin with: a percentage as the service reports it (0-100), not range-checked. Omitted for an exact or manual origin. A matched origin's refetches skip the md5 verify.

site.description: Site label, e.g. "danbooru"; empty for a url-only origin.

tag_sources.description: Per-tag source ledger keyed by the tag's category:name form (bare for general): every source that applied or re-confirmed the tag. Present on the single-image GET only.

url.description: URL of the primary (first) entry of 'sources'. Empty string when the image has no origin. Must start with http:// or https://. Settable on create and via PATCH /images/{id}.

ImageRelations.description: Declared relations centred on one image. duplicate_group / alternate_group are null when the image is not part of a group; version_parent / version_child are null and derivative_sources / derivatives empty when no edge exists.

derivative_sources.description: ids of the images this image is based on; empty when it is based on none.

version_child.description: id of the newer revision; null when this image is the chain leaf.

version_parent.description: id of the older revision; null when this image is the chain root.

created.description: Declare only: false when the edge already existed and is re-applied

MergeSummary.description: What a duplicate push or enrich folded into the existing image. The merge reconciles the source's own tag slice to the pushed set; tags owned by the operator, the auto-tagger, or another source are never touched. Tags pushed without a source are only added, and tags_added counts them too.

rating_filled.description: True when the push supplied a rating and the image had none; an existing rating is never displaced

rejected_tags.description: Pushed names the gallery rejects, dropped and counted; absent when none.

tags_retired.description: Tags this source contributed earlier and no longer lists, kept but flagged stale

request_id.description: The id to poll GET /pair/status with

token.description: The issued token, on the first poll after approval only

replaced.description: False when the uploaded bytes already matched the stored file; the metadata merge still applied

tagger_name.description: Provenance identifier: auto-tagger subfolder name when is_auto, caller-supplied 'via' (e.g. app name) when manual, null for UI-driven user adds

distinct_from.description: The same-name tags in other categories the operator marked as different things; they stop counting as a category conflict. Empty when none.

links.description: The tag's links as stored, one entry per line; a leading '-' marks a dead link.

note.description: The operator's note on the tag, in annotation markup; empty when none. An alias has none.

origin.description: Creation provenance label, as on TagRow.

last_used_at.description: ISO 8601; most recent application to an image. Absent when never applied.

origin.description: Creation provenance label: 'user', a booru site, 'ptr', an auto-tagger name, an import label. Empty on rows predating the column.

rejected.description: True when the name is rejected: every add path drops it until it is un-rejected.

applies.description: An auto-tag in the selected gallery runs it: enabled, available and in scope for the gallery

available.description: Its model loads in this build

name.description: The tagger's folder name under paths.model_path; what tagger_name takes

reason.description: Why it is unavailable; absent when it is

bearerAuth.description: Named, scoped token from Settings -> Authentication. Scopes: read (GET), write (POST/PATCH), delete (DELETE); a token missing the scope gets 403 insufficient_scope.

info.description: REST API for monbooru image library. Any operation can answer 500 internal_error on a server-side failure, and every authenticated one 503 api_disabled while no API token exists. On a desktop install whose first-run setup is not finished, every /api/v1 path answers 409 setup_required.

post.description: The file-carrying sibling of enrich: the uploaded bytes replace the existing row's file while the row and everything attached to it survive. Content-derived state (sha256, dimensions, size, type, embedded metadata, thumbnail, phash) is re-derived, annotation boxes scale to the new dimensions, and the accompanying metadata fields land through the same merge as a push. The driving origin is marked exact (similarity reset, md5 refreshed), except after a JPEG rescue (the upload re-encoded because it does not decode): that origin keeps the md5 the source served, a similarity mark of 100 and upgrade_kept, so a verified refresh applies unverified instead of answering 409 hash_mismatch. An upload whose sha256 matches the stored file applies the metadata only and answers replaced=false. Still-image and GIF rows only; a video or archive row, or a video or archive upload, is 409 wrong_type.
